architectureRendererRules.eligible: Original simple wall, floor and ceiling Renderers whose geometric envelope can be reproduced exactly by existing rebuilt modules
architectureRendererRules.originalPhysics: Keep the original GameObject, Transform and Collider active. Disable only the superseded original Renderer. Put normalized render-only children under the original object or an identity visual group.
architectureRendererRules.orientation: Use each original object's actual local quaternion as the protected baseline. Ceiling flips are per-instance authored data. Newly added render children may compensate mesh facing without editing that baseline.
architectureRendererRules.surfaces: Use existing room extents, door openings and hatch openings. Avoid coincident planar overlay and keep the prior Renderer disabled when a solid replacement fills the same envelope.
architectureRendererRules.validation: Compare exact original Collider snapshots, original wall/ceiling Transform snapshots and active gameplay component counts; check every new Renderer AABB against forbidden regions and inspect Game camera renders. These checks are not a completed puzzle playtest.
